title: Private AI Workflow Automation: A 2026 Guide
summary: Private AI workflow automation keeps sensitive corporate data behind internal firewalls. You will be able to configure secure, self-hosted environments.
body_markdown:
## Self-hosting private workflows with Activepieces Enterprise


[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/docs/llms.txt) supports central credential management and integration with secret managers, ensuring that sensitive access is governed according to enterprise security standards. This infrastructure shift ensures that agentic workflows using Claude Fable 5.1 or Gemini 3.8 Flash never leak execution metadata to third-party cloud orchestrators.


### How to run containers for automation


Activepieces provides an MIT-licensed core that runs on standard container infrastructure to ensure data sovereignty while reaching **739+ integrations** . The platform is distributed via Docker and Kubernetes, allowing engineers to map local volumes for persistent storage and connect to internal databases without opening inbound ports.


Because the Community edition supports unlimited execution runs, teams can scale high-volume tasks like document routing with Claude Haiku 5.5 without incurring the per-step tax typical of SaaS providers.


### Air-gapped installations for high-security sectors


Air-gapped means full control, not a fraction, and Activepieces does not restrict its governance suite for buyers who require the most isolation.


The same SSO, SCIM, custom RBAC, and secret manager integrations found in the managed cloud are available in the air-gapped build, a parity that allows MoneyGram and FundingSocieties to run production automation in highly regulated environments.


When the NVIDIA H100 SXM draws 700 Watts, a single high-density rack requires specialized liquid cooling to prevent thermal throttling.


The NVIDIA H100 NVL pulls 400 Watts, so dual-card configurations for large models like Mistral Large 4 demand robust power delivery at the server level. The NVIDIA H100 PCIe consumes 375 Watts, allowing for traditional air-cooled integration in standard enterprise workstations.


### Enterprise governance features


While the core engine is open, the[Activepieces Sales team](https://www.activepieces.com/sales) provides the proprietary layers required for institutional compliance.


SSO and SCIM integration provides centralized identity management. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) restricts model access by department. Comprehensive audit logs allow forensic tracking of every internal API call. Dedicated support assists with complex, air-gapped environment migrations.
